draft_en.subject: PoE switches for your shop - two neutral-brand SKUs
draft_en.body:
Hello Tehnoelectric team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 13 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE products you list, two neutral-brand switches from single units, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); budget 4-PoE + 2 uplink unmanaged - STC-114GP - $17.0. PoE injectors we do not make.

One question: which PoE switch SKU sells most in your shop - 4, 8 or 16 ports?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
